audit.why: 54.97% over 453 games with FAV and 7.5/10 matches the described shape: Neeko owns level 1 with ranged poke, Illaoi owns everything after E comes online.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 1 read Skill and row 4 read Neeko; the packet says Illaoi from level 2 onward, and the whys already claim Illaoi wins both rows.
audit.why: whys[1] says your Q range and tentacle damage out-trade her single root; whys[4] says your R ring kills her mid Pop Blossom channel. Both rows contradicted their own text and the packet chart.
audit.corrected: phases[1].side/win[1] and phases[4].side/win[4] to Illaoi, with phases[4].rating raised from 3/10 to 6/10 to match the other Illaoi rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shapesplitter (W) was described as giving Neeko 'brief invisibility' and used as her escape.
audit.why: Riot's text for Shapesplitter: passive bonus magic damage every third attack with a brief move-speed increase, active sends a clone in a direction with a recast to redirect it. There is no invisibility in the ability. Telling the player she vanishes changes how they commit E.
audit.corrected: Rewrote it as a clone plus a short speed burst, and stated Tangle-Barbs' real 12s rank-1 cooldown as the window to rip her soul.

audit.why: Tangle-Barbs at 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s is the punishable cooldown and the text already trades around it; it just lacked the number.
Neeko is female, and the surrounding content layer already uses 'she'. The mixed pronouns read as machine-generated to a paying user.
audit.corrected: Fixed phases[1].why and breakdown.feeding; other instances are template-shared strings left alone.

edits.before: Once E Test of Spirit is up, catch Neeko while her Tangle-Barbs (E) root is on cooldown and pull her soul — she has no dash and her only escape is W Shapesplitter's brief invisibility. Land E, then W Harsh Lesson in and stack Q slaps; she melts fast as a squishy mage.
edits.after: Once Test of Spirit (E) is up, catch Neeko while Tangle-Barbs is on cooldown — 12s at rank 1 — and rip her soul. She has no dash out; Shapesplitter (W) only sends a clone and gives her a short speed burst. Land E, W (Harsh Lesson) in, stack Q slaps and she melts.
